summary: This directory serves as a dedicated testing suite for verifying the logic and integration of the holiday synchronization service. It ensures that business rules regarding holiday data processing are correctly implemented and maintained during updates.
responsibilities: Verify the synchronization logic of holiday data
Validate expected outcomes for service operations
Ensure consistency and accuracy of holiday-related business processes
relationships: The test suite validates the holiday synchronization service to ensure compliance with expected business requirements.
Tests serve as a quality control mechanism for the underlying holiday data processing logic.
designDecisions: Co-location of tests with the corresponding service logic
Focus on behavioral verification through unit and integration testing
